description: This file defines the LayoutTempstoreRepository class in the Drupal layout_builder module, responsible for loading and managing layout data from temporary storage, including caching and key management.

classes.name: LayoutTempstoreRepository
classes.description: Implements layout layout storage retrieval from temporary storage with caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a shared tempstore factory.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a layout section storage from cache or tempstore.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a layout section storage exists in cache or tempstore.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a layout section storage in tempstore and cache.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a layout section storage from tempstore and cache.

methods.name: getTempstore
methods.description: Gets the shared tempstore for a given section storage.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for section storage, using either getTempstoreKey or getStorageId.
